text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during training.
As T.M. Opera O was running on the dirt track—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Phew... Hmm?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Could you bring me a mirror?
There is something about my beautiful self I wish to check.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Did some mud splash up while I was running?—
...It seems there's something on my face."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, no matter what form I take,
I remain undeniably radiant, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There doesn't seem to be anything on my face, but I decide to go grab a mirror just in case.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, keep holding it at that angle.
Now, if you'll excuse me...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Wh-What in the world...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: To think that I have become so exquisitely beautiful!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Take a look, Trainer-kun. Compared to before, my face has become far more intrepid, radiating true dignity."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Lately, amidst the grand ovations at the races,
I've felt a gaze unlike any before, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped...
One simply cannot ignore an aura so magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, no need to hide your bashfulness.
Take a loooong, close look at my face, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Being captivated by flowers is only natural. But deep down, you just want to spend your time gazing at me, the most magnificent bloom of all, right?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Let's prepare a stretcher for the next race.
Some might just faint at the mere sight of me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is this too a sin born of being too beautiful?
Yet even that sin, I shall accept...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O was intoxicated with herself even more than usual.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... To think that I was... this beautiful...
choice_data_list: Isn't it the same as usual...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If you really think so,
your eye still has a long way to go, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, worry not! I shall teach you a method
that even you can easily use to hone your discerning eye.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look into my eyes 100 times a day.
Hehe, easy enough, right?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's no better subject for studying beauty, after all.
Oh, and you should write a report on it too.
Submit it, and I'll grade it for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after that, I was made to stare at T.M. Opera O's face...
